tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: "Are you from London?"

B builds the answer from the tiles. Put the blue verb into the right form and start with the little word: actually, well, so, anyway, by the way, to be honest. Remember: actually means "in fact", not "now".
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: In fact – I'm correcting you politely.

tandemRedemittel.p1: Sorry? Can you say that again, please?

tandemFragen.antwort: Well, it was a bit long, but fine.

tandemFragen.frage: So, what do we need today?
tandemFragen.antwort: Anyway, we need a decision on the budget.
By the way, the plumber called me yesterday.

tandemFragen.frage: What did you think of the film?
tandemFragen.antwort: To be honest, I found it a bit slow.
Actually, I passed with top marks.
So, the bus broke down and I walked.

tandemFragen.frage: Why did you leave your job?
tandemFragen.antwort: I mean, the pay was bad.

tandemFragen.frage: Does Zofia still work in London?
tandemFragen.antwort: Actually, she moved to Bristol last month.
